lines.t: Verse 1:
Shabbat is here, the candles light the room,
We rest in Messiah, let peace now bloom.
A steadfast stone for Your holy name,
Walking upright, our hearts aflame.
Turning not left, nor to the right,
We journey in truth, in love and light.
Shabbat Shalom, Shabbat Shalom,
We remember Your days, we sing this song.
In Messiah’s shadow, we find our peace,
Shabbat Shalom, our joys increase.
Verse 2:
You are pleased in all we do,
Your commandments kept, Your word is true.
Holy Sabbaths, we won’t forget,
Every seventh day, Your love we’ve met.
Grafted in, called Your own,
Together in Your rest, as one.
Shabbat Shalom, Shabbat Shalom,
We remember Your days, we sing this song.
In Messiah’s shadow, we find our peace,
Shabbat Shalom, our joys increase.
From week to week, we wait for this day,
To rest and rejoice, in Your perfect way.
Families gathered, singing Your praise,
Shabbat Shalom, our hearts we raise.
Shabbat Shalom, Shabbat Shalom,
We remember Your days, we sing this song.
In Messiah’s shadow, we find our peace,
Shabbat Shalom, our joys increase.
Continue in the Way, let peace remain,
Shabbat Shalom, we proclaim Your name.
